_comment: Ten postings, chosen by FAILURE MODE rather than by variety — one per way the reader
can break. Every URL was verified live on 2026-09-20; postings expire, so a run that
reports JOB_NOT_FOUND on one row is a dead link, not a regression. Re-source it.
`expect` is what we BELIEVE should happen, not an assertion. The harness prints
believed-vs-actual so a surprise is visible; it never fails a run over one.
The two `paste` rows carry real employer text with the formatting damage a human paste
actually inflicts. The words are the employer's; only the shape was broken.

postings.probes: Greenhouse hosted board — the most common ATS we had never once tested

expect.note: no JSON-LD on the page at all — verified

postings.probes: Ashby — a React board that still emits JSON-LD; two JobPosting blocks, so findJobPosting has to choose
Workday — the enterprise ATS, served as a 14KB shell
A SECOND Flair tenant — the double-escaped JSON-LD that produced raw HTML in the JD box
Jobberman NG — three JobPosting blocks on one page
MyJobMag NG — its single ld+json block is UNPARSEABLE, so this must survive on the DOM/page path

expect.note: verified: JSON.parse throws on its ld+json

postings.probes: Bot wall. Indeed answers 403 with a captcha page

expect.note: a CLEAN refusal is the pass; garbage text is the failure

postings.probes: Pasted from Word: smart quotes, bullet glyphs, non-breaking spaces, tab indents, hard wraps mid-sentence
postings.title: Finance & Admin Officer

postings.probes: Pasted from LinkedIn: About-the-job preamble, emoji where headings were, bullets flattened to prose, Show more. Also THIN (~600 chars) and names three alternative degree fields — the qualification trap
postings.title: Marketing & Business Development Officer

expect.note: expect the degree fields to be the hard part
